title: Ask HN: As a person, what can I do to improve a city?

To get out of the situation, which is understandable. However, this causes a brain drain and leave the city in a worse place. I don't want to do that, I want to uplift if I can. What is the micro thing I can do today, that can have a chance of a macro change tomorrow?
